$comment: #1420 / F-219 / OD-158. The ONE list of extractor reasons that mean the document itself STATES a field does not apply or is not printed. Read by scraper/scripts/answer_states.py (state STATED_NOT_PRINTED) and by scraper/src/config/stated-absence-reasons.ts. A reason belongs here only when the extractor emits it after reading a printed statement of absence; a reason emitted because a pattern found nothing (a *_not_in_document / *_not_found miss) never does, because OD-158 clears a stored value on a stated absence and keeps it on a miss.

reasons.printedStatement: PRICE TO EARNINGS RATIO IS NOT ASCERTAINABLE

the last-three-years row prints Not Applicable
